instruction: A realistic wide-angle photograph of a dance studio with dark walls and a wooden floor. On the left, the man in the rust-brown shirt (R3) similarly supports the woman in the yellow shirt (R4) on his back. All wear black pants and are barefoot. On the right, a bystander pair in matching yellow and brown shirts performs the same pose. The studio is evenly lit, highlighting the dancers' synchronized athletic poses.
